Zone Four is our own artist project, the live proof of concept for everything we run. It started at 57 monthly listeners, with Sahaya AGI reading the streaming signals daily to pick the songs and time every push.

Across a multi-song campaign from Feb 1st to May 1st 2026, the project pulled 224K streams and 17K playlist adds, reaching 75.4K monthly listeners. The same system, run on the same data-first principles we apply to every artist.

From 57 to 75.4K monthly listeners. The exact playbook we run for you.

Jamilah came to us at 92 monthly listeners. Sahaya AGI flagged "African In New York" as the track with the strongest underlying signals, and we timed a campaign to the moment its momentum started to build.

Inside two weeks the release pulled 17,500 streams and 977 playlist adds, taking her past 14.4K monthly listeners. Every pound of spend landed where the data said it would work hardest.

From 92 to 14.4K+. The right song, pushed at the right moment, with the budget behind it.
